messages.text: IC here. Checkout requests are timing out after 30s. Who is on payment-gateway?
on it. gateway p95 is 11s, threads are blocked waiting for a db connection from the pool
we ran the ledger index migration last night (CHG-2043), could this be lock contention on ledgerdb?
checked pg_locks and pg_stat_activity on ledgerdb: no lock waits, and the index build finished at 22:40 yesterday. ruling out CHG-2043
pool is pinned at 60/60. that's the size we set in CHG-2041 on Monday
fraud-scoring p99 jumped to ~450ms around 13:50. v3.3 went to 100% at 09:30 but the afternoon peak is when it hurts
decision: roll back the fraud model to v3.2 first, then raise the gateway pool
rollback to v3.2 complete (CHG-2047). p99 back to 85ms
pool raised to 150 (CHG-2048), not 200: the new ledgerdb instance only has 200 max_connections and ledger-service needs headroom
all metrics normal. resolving INC-2026-0311. postmortem owner: Priya
FYI notification-service has a backlog of ~30k receipt events from the incident, draining now, ETA 1-2h
